paragraphs.text: Phabine , Boss's Confidant is a Leonin advisor in New Capenna .

Phabine wears fashionable clothes, and has her blonde hair styled in a bob. She wears glasses and takes notes in a book while her clients divulge their stories in her office, giving the impression she is a therapist by trade. She reports to the crime boss Jetmir of the Cabaretti and her notes undoubtedly hold many valuable secrets.
